# Vantage Point Web Design

> Vantage Point Web Design rebuilds small local business websites so they record where every
> lead actually came from, audits the customer information the business already has, and keeps
> the whole thing connected to the system they already use. Based in Orange County, California.
> Serving home services and local trades: plumbers, HVAC, electricians, roofers, landscapers,
> salons, restaurants and similar.

## The problem we work on

Most small business customer systems collapse paid search, Google Local Services, the maps
listing and organic traffic into a single "Google" bucket. Leads that arrive by phone, which
in home services is most of them, usually record no source at all. Advertising spend is almost
never stored alongside the job record. The result is that the owner cannot tell which money
produced which job.

## What we sell

- **Website rebuild, from $1,500 one time.** Built to record where every lead came from. The
  campaign is carried from the ad through to the form. The phone number is tracked. Booking
  and quote requests log a source.
- **Data audit, $1,500 to $3,000 one time.** From one export, with no logins and no account
  access: who has gone quiet at 12, 18 and 24 months, which quotes were sent and never followed
  up, who actually sends referrals, seasonal booking patterns, geographic clustering, who was
  never asked for a review, and what is duplicated or blank.
- **Monthly upkeep, $799 to $1,500 per month.** We maintain the tracking, watch for silent
  failures, reconcile against the client's own books, and deliver three decisions a month with
  a dollar figure attached to each. Cancel any time.

## How we are different

- **All prices are published.** Most competitors quote only after a sales call.
- **The client owns every account.** Website, customer system, advertising accounts and domain
  are all created in the client's name and billing, with us added as a user they can remove.
- **We do not hold customer data.** Records stay in the client's own system. We keep only a
  small derived file connecting advertising cost to jobs, exportable or deletable on request.
- **We do not send marketing on a client's behalf.** Campaigns go out from software the client
  already pays for, which keeps messaging compliance with the vendor insured for it.
- **We are independent of ad spend.** We do not run the ads, so we have no reason to report
  favourably on them.
